gloss: irradiation; exposure to light or radiation

definitions.gloss: irradiation; beam exposure; shining light on
definitions.explanation: The act of directing light, radiation, or other energy beams onto a target. Used in medical, scientific, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: レーザー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{照射|しょうしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{照射|しょうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{殺菌|さっきん}→殺菌：09781_sakkin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To sterilize by exposure to ultraviolet light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{放射線|ほうしゃせん}→放射線：14998_houshasen⟧{照射|しょうしゃ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ともなうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Treatment by radiation exposure can have side effects.

notes:
Composed of {照|しょう} (to shine) + {射|しゃ} (to emit, shoot). A technical term commonly used in medicine (radiation therapy), science (UV irradiation), and technology (laser applications). The verb form is {照射|しょうしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{放射線|ほうしゃせん}→放射線：14998_houshasen⟧{照射|しょうしゃ}: radiation exposure; radiotherapy
- レーザー{照射|しょうしゃ}: laser irradiation
- ⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧{照射|しょうしゃ}: UV irradiation
- {照射|しょうしゃ}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: dosage; amount of irradiation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{被曝|ひばく}→被曝：22759_hibaku⟧: radiation exposure (involuntary) — implies being exposed to radiation, often harmful
- ⟦{放射|ほうしゃ}→放射：16334_housha⟧: radiation; emission — the act of radiating energy outward
- ⟦{日光浴|にっこうよく}→日光浴：21203_nikkouyoku⟧: sunbathing — natural exposure to sunlight
